dataset: Actual national generation by technology, daily energy
transformations: Complete response preserved as compact JSON; no observation values changed. API totals retained in source and excluded by default by the parser. Plot divides MWh by 1000 to show GWh.
attribution: Source: Red Eléctrica de España (REData). Source last-update fields remain in the fixture.
limitations: System totals by technology, not plant telemetry; no total estimated self-consumption; source may revise past values. No renewable share or missing interval is imputed.
